$comment: C17.2 F — BUNDLED THIRD-PARTY STACK of @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64.
This package ships ONE prebuilt shared library that statically bundles roughly thirty
third-party libraries. C17 recorded only the package-level LGPL-3.0-or-later declaration,
so every bundled library's own terms — MPL, BSD, MIT, zlib, IJG, the AOM patent grant,
and the fontconfig, freetype, libpng and libtiff licences — went unrecorded, along with
Component versions come from the shipped versions.json; the component LIST and its terms
come from the shipped README table. Both are bound by digest below. Prose terms are mapped
to SPDX through a code-owned table, and any term the table does not cover FAILS CLOSED
rather than being guessed — a licence is not something to infer.
These libraries are deliberately NOT added to the C16 npm SBOM: they are not npm
components and the SBOM describes the npm closure. They are a separate C17 legal
subcomponent inventory, which is what the obligations actually attach to.

commit_binding.why: A tag is mutable; the commit is not. The source offer resolves to this commit, so a recipient obtains the exact recipe this binary was built from even if the tag moves.

aom_patent_grant.note: The Alliance for Open Media Patent License 1.0 accompanies aom's BSD-2-Clause grant. SPDX publishes no identifier for it, so no canonical text is vendored and the licence text obligation is discharged by the upstream document named below rather than by a pinned SPDX text. Recorded explicitly instead of being silently dropped.
